## Purpose

Fix mypy typing for the P model group and remove its exclusion from the mypy pre-commit hook. The changes use precise annotations, modality-specific typed data, overloads, and runtime narrowing across PaddleOCR-VL, PaliGemma, Param2MoE, Phi-3V, Phi-4MM, and Plamo3. 

This contributes to #26533.

## Reproducer

On `main`, remove `r"vllm/model_executor/models/[pP]",` from `EXCLUDE` in `tools/pre_commit/mypy.py`, then run:

```bash
.venv/bin/pre-commit run mypy-3.12 --all-files --hook-stage manual
```

Run the same command on this branch without modifying the exclusion list.

## Output on main

```text
Found 70 errors in 8 files (checked 1351 source files)
```

## Output on branch

```text
Passed
```

```
